title: rhamnus discolor
intro: Rhamnus discolor, commonly known as the New Zealand black titoki or titoki, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to New Zealand. It is valued for its traditional medicinal uses and has been used for centuries in Maori medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant's leaves and bark are rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant is also used to treat digestive issues, fever, and skin conditions, and is said to have a calming effect on the nervous system.
